title: Microphone settings
text:
Microphone settings

Preferred microphone

Choose which microphone mausVoice should use when recording. Automatic picks the best available device each time.

Keep the microphone ready

Start dictating instantly by opening the microphone ahead of time. Your system shows its microphone-in-use indicator the whole time this is on.

Audio kept before the press

0.5 s
How much speech to keep from just before you press, so a word you start early is not cut off.
This only applies while the microphone is already open. Turn on holding it open above, or the press has to open it first and nothing from before it was captured.
Stay ready after a dictation

Keeps the microphone open for a few seconds after each recording, so a second dictation starts instantly. Your system shows its microphone-in-use indicator for that time.

Test your microphone

Start a short test to see live audio levels and play back what was recorded.
